I get the feeling his nemisis could be Ra.   "Becoming partly magical themself" may be a reference to Blake Washington Jr. being transformed into Ra after grabing the staff, much like Bugbear's powers are tied to the stone.  Plus, he was in an old pyramid when he changed, implying some connection to some Mesoamerican god or gods.
